prompt: An analog photograph in the Polaroid style, with its characteristic uniform white border. The image shows a medium-shot portrait of the attached model, her face, expression, and clothing unaltered. The model is obscured and distorted by a thick sheet of fine-grained, textured, hammered glass, which creates an optical mosaic pattern and subtly blurs her facial features and her color-blocked top (black, white, terracotta). Dense vines of green ivy (Hedera helix) are in the foreground, sharp and in focus, framing the top, left, and bottom edges of the composition, overlapping the glass and the subject. The focus is split, with the ivy leaves in the foreground sharp and the woman behind them heavily filtered and softened by the texture of the glass. Natural, diffused lighting, with a color palette dominated by deep greens and muted skin tones. A large depth of field integrates the foreground and background. The photographic grain texture is visible.

promptZh: 一张采用 宝丽来风格 的模拟摄影照片，具有标志性的统一白边。画面展示了所附模特的半身像，其面部、表情和服装保持不变。模特被一层厚厚的细颗粒状 锤纹玻璃 遮挡并扭曲，形成了光学马赛克图案，并微妙地模糊了她的面部特征和拼色上衣（黑色、白色、赤陶色）。前景中是茂密的 绿常春藤 (Hedera helix) 藤蔓，清晰对焦，勾勒出构图的顶部、左侧和底部边缘，与玻璃和主体重叠。焦点采用分焦处理，前景的常春藤叶片清晰，而身后的女性则被玻璃的质感深度过滤并柔化。自然漫射光，色调以深绿色和柔和的肤色为主。大景深将前景和背景融为一体。可见摄影胶片的颗粒质感。
